title: Sidney Desvigne's band and the steamer Capitol
summary: He worked with Desvigne's ten-piece band and played local dates on the steamer Capitol.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: mostly field work but Sidney for before I went that outfit he traveled lots of time up and down the river on the steamer capitol
did you ever play the capitol you mentioned the other boat you played

yeah well I never made a trip with him I just played you know local engagements on the capitol such as the present but I never made a regular river trip with him all the way up the same port and I just played locally on special occasions only and I worked with that outfit and from Sidney's band when we drift around and playing stuff

different bands around the city here. And when they went into the Depression days, come in, and we were just playing, we formed a little small band with Mealy Bones, Bob Antony trumpet, Salmon, you know, his brother was there.
